propositions: Pin drift, missing targets, or malformed pin records must invalidate plan-review attestations when enforce_plan_material_pins is enabled, and report the same as advisory when disabled.

The DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract must aggregate target pin status by severity (malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current) and expose pinned versus current fingerprints per target.

Optional enforcement configuration must read from VerifyConfig.enforce_plan_material_pins with key-local fail-open semantics: ConfigError returns false and emits plan_material_pin_config_unreadable without raising.

Re-sign recovery must validate reviewed_related_material persisted in the sidecar through derive_plan_material_pin_health without calling compute_validity, while retaining the own-material staleness guard.

The PlanValidityProfile (DEFAULT, CLOSE, DRIFT_REFRESH) must allow selective check disabling at call sites, with CLOSE and DRIFT_REFRESH both disabling code freshness while retaining signature, registry, own-material, and pin validity.

Full LLM review must thread the exact pre-LLM review_snapshot.related_material through sidecar.emit and build_payload as an optional ordered list, preserving plan_review_result_v2 schema and legacy compatibility.
